7.24.2 Notification mechanism using multiple CAN Drivers
Even if multiple
CanDrvs
are used in a single ECU Every notification callback service
invoked by
CanDrvs
at the
CanIf
exists only once. This means, that
CanIf
has to
identify calling
CanDrv
using the passed parameters.
CanIf
identifies the calling
CanDrv
from the
ControllerId
within the Mailbox (
Can_HwType
) structure.
